correctness.rationale: The source defines \(N=S+Q+E+I+A+R\) and states \(\dot\lambda=-\partial H/\partial x\). Direct symbolic differentiation of the displayed Hamiltonian produces incidence derivatives with respect to all six states, the quarantine coefficient \((\lambda_1-\lambda_2)u_3\), and the factor \(\sigma\rho\) in the exposed costate. The bundled checker reconstructs these identities exactly. A terminal expansion also shows that the omitted recovered-costate incidence term is nonzero on a generic positive interior optimal trajectory.

value.rationale: The paper explicitly uses its optimality system for numerical control simulations and concludes that the resulting media/quarantine strategy minimizes infected populations and control cost. Because equation (6.2) is not the Hamiltonian adjoint and the missing terms are active near the terminal time, the printed system cannot certify those controls as optimal. The correction is therefore directly relevant to reproducibility and interpretation of Figure 7.
